newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Interform Ceramics to buy China factory.
newsitem.headline: Interform Ceramics to buy China factory.

text.p: Ceramics maker and distributor Interform Ceramics Technologies Ltd said on Thursday it will buy 50 percent of a China ceramics factory from Guangdong Foshan Guzao Industry General Co for an undisclosed sum.
The consideration represented a price/earnings ratio of about four times, Interform said in a statement.
It said estimated annual profit of the factory, Guangdong Foshan Guzao Ceramics Factory, was about 20 million yuan.
The factory specialises in the production of glazed ceramic tiles and has an annual production capacity of four million square meters, it added.
